name: 5x1
subtitle: Apps for revived Jibo robots
description: Apps from 5x1, the free public server for Jibo. Your phone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as your Jibo.

apps.name: BEep
apps.subtitle: Your Jibo, in your pocket.
apps.localizedDescription:
BEep finds your Jibo on your Wi-Fi and opens BEacon, his control panel, with the iOS 26 Liquid Glass design.

• Finds every Jibo on your Wi-Fi by itself and remembers them
• Status, Screen, Music, Photos, People, Store, Server and Settings
• Save Jibo's photos to your library and upload from your phone
• Save Jibo's photos automatically, low-battery alerts, and your iPhone calendar for personal reports
• Battery widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Add a robot by IP address if it isn't found

Jibo needs BEam with BEacon.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Liquid Glass throughout BEacon, all in 5x1 green
• The tab bar's selection is a sliding glass bubble you can drag
• Store is in the tab bar, with a Details button and popup; More has Server and Settings
• The home screen no longer scrolls when everything fits
• Convert a Jibo to 5x1 now only asks for his IP address
• Convert a Jibo to 5x1: enter a modded Jibo's IP address and BEep installs 5x1 on him over SSH, showing its progress
• Removes the Music tab, since Jibo's Jukebox is gone. Jibo's Music player and AirPlay replace it
• Fixes the battery widget's Jibo list being empty after updating from an earlier BEep
• Choose which Jibo the battery widget shows: long-press it › Edit Widget › Jibo
• Jibo's battery widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen

• Save Jibo's new photos to your iPhone
• Get a notification when Jibo's battery is low
• Use your iPhone's calendar for someone's personal report

Switch them on for each robot in More › Settings › On this iPhone.
